caption: The drawing depicts a single green sleeveless dress displayed flat against a plain off-white background. The dress has a fitted bodice and a flared skirt. There are decorative elements featuring a red and white plaid pattern: edging the armholes, neckline, and forming bands at the waist and near the skirt’s hem. The plaid bands are angled slightly along the waist and hem. The dress appears to be made of a smooth, possibly woolen or cotton fabric, and the drawing presents the texture and folds in a realistic manner. There is a faint signature reading "Mary D. Prosser" in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Child's Dress
